headline: Growth streak continues as management lifts the outlook
summary_short: American Healthcare REIT's Q2 2026 revenue rose to $674M (+24.3% y/y) and diluted EPS climbed to $0.16 from $0.06, while total portfolio Same-Store NOI growth hit 13.2% — a tenth straight quarter of double-digit gains. Management raised full-year 2026 NFFO-per-share and Same-Store NOI growth guidance.
summary_long: Growth was led by the SHOP and ISHC segments, where disciplined revenue management and expense control drove Same-Store NOI growth of 20.5% and 16.1% respectively against 13.2% for the total portfolio. Net income more than tripled y/y to $31M as margin expansion (operating margin ~20.4% vs ~19.0% a year ago) outpaced a sharp rise in depreciation tied to $1.4 billion of year-to-date acquisitions. The company raised FY2026 guidance, lifting NFFO per diluted share to $2.15-$2.19 (from $2.03-$2.09) and total portfolio Same-Store NOI growth to 11.0%-13.0% (from 9.0%-12.0%). Cash rose to $157M and equity climbed to $3.7B on an $811.4M follow-on equity offering plus ATM issuances; net debt-to-annualized adjusted EBITDA improved to 2.5x from 3.0x q/q.

drivers.explanation: Revenue grew on resident-fees growth in the SHOP and ISHC segments plus $126.9M of new SHOP investments this quarter ($1.4B year-to-date), and total portfolio Same-Store NOI growth of 13.2% led by disciplined revenue management and expense control.
Basic EPS rose to $0.16 from $0.06 y/y tracking the net income increase, though the gain was partly diluted by a larger weighted share count (192.7M vs 160.5M) from forward-equity settlements.
Diluted EPS rose to $0.16 from $0.06 y/y on the same net income growth, tempered by the ~20% larger diluted share count following ATM and follow-on equity issuances.
Property operating expenses rose in step with portfolio growth from new SHOP acquisitions ($126.9M this quarter, $1.4B year-to-date), the release's stated driver of transactional activity.

Operating income (NOI) growth of 33% y/y was driven by 20.5% Same-Store NOI growth in SHOP and 16.1% in ISHC via occupancy gains, dynamic revenue management, and expense discipline, per the COO's remarks.
Pretax income nearly tripled y/y as NOI growth was reinforced by lower net interest expense ($18.6M vs $22.6M) and a swing to a $5.6M gain on dispositions from a $2.7M loss a year ago.

Net income growth outpaced revenue growth mainly from NOI expansion and lower interest expense, though a sharp rise in depreciation and amortization ($72.1M vs $41.9M y/y) from recent acquisitions partly offset the gain.
Cash rose q/q as the Company raised approximately $433.2M via ATM forward sale agreements and issued shares for gross proceeds of $228.7M during the quarter to fund its SHOP acquisitions.
Equity rose q/q on net income plus the May 2026 follow-on common equity offering (16,100,000 shares, ~$811.4M gross proceeds) and continued ATM issuances during the quarter.
Diluted share count rose as the Company physically settled 4,704,556 shares under its ATM Program this quarter, part of a broader forward-equity program funding its acquisition pipeline.

AHR posted its tenth consecutive quarter of double-digit Same-Store NOI growth, funded over $1.4B of year-to-date SHOP acquisitions with forward equity, improved leverage by half a turn, and raised full-year NFFO and NOI-growth guidance.
